name: Hotter
description: The temperature of your Mac in the Control Center, with a color that turns red as it heats up.
author: Giuseppe
details: The temperature of your Mac, as the button itself: green when cool, red as it heats up. Open it for the average or the highest reading, °C or °F, and a graph of the last minutes. Apple silicon only.
features: Temperature as the button, green to red
permissions: Reads the temperature sensors. No permission needed.
